meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 它会把 HEAD 与最新发布的 npm 版本对比，按发布层列出所有未发布的改动，逐条读 diff 说明真实变化和影响，并给出各层与整体的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你提到「unpublished changes」「changelog」「what changed」等关键词，或想知道哪些改动还没发布时触发；它会直接给出分析，不提问、不寒暄。

say.text: 列出还没发布的改动，按发布层分类
say.note: 直接输出分层改动清单和版本建议

say.text: HEAD 和已发布的 oh-my-opencode 之间改了什么？
say.note: 逐条读 diff 说明真实变化

say.text: lazycodex-ai 该用哪种版本号升级？
say.note: 给出该层的 patch/minor/major 建议

howto.what_en: It compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions and lists all unpublished changes by release layer, describing each change from the real diff and recommending a version bump per layer plus one overall.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog", "what changed" or similar, or ask what hasn't shipped yet. It outputs the analysis immediately, with no questions.

say_en.text: List the unpublished changes by release layer
say_en.note: Outputs a layered change list and version advice

say_en.text: What changed on HEAD since the published oh-my-opencode?
say_en.note: Reads the diffs and describes the real changes
